sources.title: Heat Networks Delivery Unit
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.verified_claim: DESNZ states heat-network zoning will identify areas where heat networks are expected to be the lowest-cost low-carbon heating option and is developing a future five-year zone pipeline.

sources.title: Heat network zoning
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.verified_claim: The government collection links the statutory and consultation framework for heat-network zoning under the Energy Act 2023; collection membership is not a candidate zone designation.

sources.title: Proposals for heat network zoning 2023
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.verified_claim: The 2026 government response covers zoning bodies, identifying and designating zones, connection requirements, delivery and enforcement; exact zone geography is still required.

sources.title: Heat network zoning consultation 2023: summary of government response
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.verified_claim: The response summary describes zone identification, refinement, designation, delivery, consent, review, enforcement and appeals; policy status alone cannot be applied to a parcel.

sources.title: Heat networks regulation: registration
sources.verified_claim: Ofgem registration guidance sets regulatory registration obligations for relevant heat-network operators and suppliers; it does not establish whether a candidate is served by a network.

sources.title: Heat networks regulation: consumer protection
sources.verified_claim: Ofgem's 2026 consumer-protection rules cover service, billing, contracts, vulnerable consumers and security of supply; they are network/operator obligations, not parcel development evidence.

sources.title: Heat networks regulation: fair pricing and cost allocation
sources.verified_claim: Ofgem guidance sets fair-pricing and cost-allocation principles for regulated heat networks; price regulation is contextual until a specific network relationship is proven.

sources.title: Heat networks in London
sources.verified_claim: The London Assembly research explainer describes London heat networks, heat sources and zoning using GLA and DESNZ data; exact candidate linkage requires a mapped zone or network.
